set.Description: Set label used in Andrzejak et al. (2001).

Levels.C: interictal, hippocampal formation of the opposite hemisphere (source N.zip)
Levels.D: interictal, within the epileptogenic zone (source F.zip)

source_label.Description: Letter used in the source file names (N, F, S).

segment_index.Description: Number in the source file name (e.g. F037.txt -> 37). Segments are randomized by the source with regard to recording contact and patient; the index carries no patient or contact information.

recording_region.Description: Recording region of the set as described in Andrzejak et al. (2001).

source_archive.Description: Source zip archive (copied byte-identically to sourcedata/upf-repositori-10230-42894/).

source_member.Description: Text file inside the source archive from which this run was converted.

source_member_sha256.Description: SHA-256 of the uncompressed source text file.

n_samples.Description: Number of samples in the source file (4097 in every file; the source page and the paper state 4096).

n_samples_at_2047.Description: Number of samples equal to 2047, the largest value of a signed 12-bit converter; such samples are likely clipped at the converter limit.

n_samples_at_minus2048.Description: Number of samples equal to -2048, the smallest value of a signed 12-bit converter.
